basis: Actual current STEP material sections at X planes; adaptive area/centroid/inertia of exact planar section faces. Euler-Bernoulli vertical bending; ideal continuous bonds, fully fixed receiver at X50.2mm; no foam stiffness credit, no joint slip, shear deflection, torsion, buckling or nonlinear effects. E values are illustrative assumptions, not measured material or strength limits. Uniform lift over each exposed X53..1000mm half-wing.
load_scaling: Reference load only: stress, curvature and linear deflection multiply by (actual_mass_kg/2)*(load_factor_g/3). This is not a 2kg design-mass assumption or a safe load factor.
